author: Gunnvald Stone-Hand
pages:
Day 12. Quartz and a trace of silver in the creek bed. Followed it up the slope. Promising.

Day 14. Found the vein. Thick as my arm where it shows, then it dives into the rock. Need a proper pick and someone to hold the lamp.
Day 15. Went back to town for supplies and told no one. Came back and the vein is still there, but so are footprints that aren't mine. Big ones. I am sleeping with the axe tonight.
